segments.caption: Three children joyfully run toward and dive into a large pile of autumn leaves in a grassy field, laughing and tumbling before springing up and scattering leaves in playful celebration.
Three children playfully jump and toss autumn leaves in a yard, their energetic movements kicking up a flurry of brown foliage as they run and laugh near a parked truck and house.

In a backyard covered in fallen leaves, three children are energetically playing, tossing and jumping in a large pile. A woman watches from the driveway near a parked maroon pickup truck and a black car. The children’s playful antics create a lively, autumnal scene.
Children run and play across a leaf-strewn yard in front of a house, while an adult walks toward them on the driveway, with parked vehicles and a dog nearby.

A woman walks across a residential driveway toward a parked car, while children play in the yard. One child runs across the yard carrying a bundle of leaves, then tosses them onto the driveway, scattering them as he runs past. The scene takes place on a leafy, autumn day in front of a house, with a dog and a child’s bicycle also visible.

In a backyard covered in fallen autumn leaves, a young boy runs across the yard carrying a bundle of leaves, playfully tossing them into the air. He is soon joined by two young girls, and together they gather and throw leaves, enjoying a carefree game of leaf-tossing. The scene is set in a residential area with a house, parked vehicles, and a child's toy car visible, capturing the simple, joyful energy of children playing outdoors in the fall.
Children play energetically in a leaf-covered yard, running, tumbling, and throwing leaves in joyful, carefree motion.
Three children play energetically in a leaf-strewn yard, chasing each other and tossing a ball, their joyful movement contrasting with the quiet autumn setting beside a parked truck.
